item.title: Novastart vs ChromeOS Which Approach Makes Sense for You
item.content:encoded:
ChromeOS makes sense to evaluate when your work is centered on websites and online services. Novastart is worth considering when that work needs a different spatial arrangement or a shared application workspace. Both can be relevant to browser-heavy tasks, but they approach the computing experience from different directions.

The decision should begin with the machine and applications you need. ChromeOS belongs to its own device and operating-system environment. Novastart has its own supported installation routes. Do not assume that comparing their workspace ideas means Novastart can be installed or tried on every Chromebook. Verify the actual route before planning a trial.

A browser centered working day

ChromeOS is a practical candidate for people whose core tasks happen through web services. Email, shared documents, online project tools, and other websites can form a coherent working set. The important question is whether those services cover your whole job, including occasional exceptions. A platform that handles routine tasks well may still leave a specialized requirement unresolved.

List the tasks you do away from a connection, the files you exchange, and the external equipment you use. Test each one rather than assuming that browser-centered means universally sufficient. Some work fits an online service environment very well. Other work depends on software or device behavior that needs a different setup.

A canvas centered working day

Novastart focuses on arranging application work spatially. This can matter even when most of the tools are web services. A person preparing a proposal may want the client brief, a pricing sheet, and the draft visible as a connected group. The canvas offers a way to organize those relationships instead of navigating a long collection of browser tabs.

That model introduces a different habit. You need to choose where the project begins, keep the main output easy to find, and distinguish active work from supporting references. Spatial organization is helpful when it reflects the task. A large unstructured canvas can require as much searching as an overfilled browser, so useful boundaries remain important.

The overlap does not remove compatibility checks

If both workflows use the same online services, compare their behavior in the actual environments. Sign in, open representative files, edit them, and check the completed outputs. Include account switching if you work for more than one client. A convenient workspace should make the current identity clear enough that you do not accidentally edit the right document through the wrong account.

Do not equate browser access with native application compatibility. A web service may be all you need, or it may provide only part of a desktop program's functionality. Document the exact feature that matters, such as an export or a specific spreadsheet operation. This turns compatibility into an answerable question instead of a general assumption.

How the team participates

A ChromeOS team can collaborate effectively through shared online applications. If the task is one document, that may be sufficient. A canvas becomes more interesting when a review involves several sources and outputs at once. The question is whether a common working arrangement helps the group contribute with less narration and repeated navigation.

Try a review involving a draft and its supporting evidence. Ask one person to check a claim while another revises the wording. Record any coordination required. The best experience should make the result clearer and easier to verify. More simultaneous activity is not automatically better if participants lose track of who is changing the authoritative content.

Run a focused pilot

Use a project that reflects your normal working day. Gather material, create a deliverable, share it for feedback, and return after a break. Note how easily you find the current tools and resume the task. Include the setup effort, device constraints, and any workarounds. A fair comparison should describe the total experience rather than highlighting only one attractive interaction.

Choose ChromeOS when its environment fits the device and application requirements and makes the job straightforward. Consider Novastart when spatial project organization or shared application work solves a recurring problem. Let a completed task guide the choice. The useful distinction is between two approaches to everyday work, each of which should be judged against the work you actually need to finish.

Also consider the people receiving your output. Ask a collaborator to open the final file and respond through the normal review channel. A workspace choice is stronger when its convenience for you also produces a straightforward handoff for the next person in the process.

item.title: Managing domicile and permanent residence requirements for government jobs in Uttarakhand
item.content:encoded:
The Uttarakhand government jobs recruitment may have certain domicile and resident criteria. These are especially necessary for some recruitment processes at the state level, where applicants have to show their association with the state either by producing their proof of residence or through any other way such as educational or job registration certificates. As eligibility criteria may vary from department to department, it is essential that the applicant checks the recruitment notification before applying.

Understanding the Basic Eligibility Conditions

In case of many government recruitments for Uttarakhand, especially certain Group C recruitments, there could be more than one criterion for qualifying as specified in the recruitment norms.

One such criterion could be that of possessing a valid Uttarakhand Permanent Resident Certificate, which can be provided by the concerned authority like Tehsildar or Sub-Divisional Magistrate.

Another criterion for qualification could be that of having completed both High School and Intermediate from any recognized educational institution in Uttarakhand, wherever applicable. Valid registration at the District Employment Office in Uttarakhand could also be a criterion, subject to a cut-off date.

Other Categories Covered Under the Rules

Some types of applicants may be eligible based on certain provisions. This includes the employees of the armed forces, paramilitary forces or Central/State Government departments working in Uttarakhand based on certain terms mentioned in the recruitment rules.

In some instances, even the spouse or the children of such individuals may qualify for equivalent eligibility. Likewise, permanent residents of Uttarakhand residing outside Uttarakhand for work, education or other valid reasons shall be considered as residents of Uttarakhand.

It is advisable that the candidates should read the advertisement carefully rather than have a general knowledge about the domicile rule of Uttarakhand.

Domicile and Reservation Are Not Always the Same

There is a need to note that there is no relationship between the eligibility to apply for a particular job and obtaining the certificate for the particular reservation benefit.

Recruitments will at times permit the applicants to apply for the job but have different criteria for applying for reservation in Uttarakhand or horizontal reservation. For instance, benefits pertaining to women, OBC, SC, ST, disabled persons and others may require certificates from the concerned authorities in a particular format.

This implies that an applicant needs to consider two different things:

  • Am I eligible to apply for the job?
  • Am I eligible to claim the benefit of reservation?

The answer to these questions may not always be the same.

Legal Issues Surrounding Domicile Rules

The domicile-based recruitment eligibility conditions have been subject to judicial challenge in Uttarakhand. The courts have analyzed the issues regarding domicile conditions and the power of the state to fix eligibility conditions.

Pursuant to Article 16(3) of the Constitution, the Parliament has the power to fix residence conditions for some government jobs. It is thus not correct to think that all domicile conditions are illegal and apply to all government jobs.

The recent cases on recruitment from Uttarakhand also make it clear that the exact eligibility conditions as per the recruitment conditions must be satisfied.

Can Marriage Change Domicile Benefits?

However, marriage alone will not qualify someone for the reservation benefits related to the domicile of Uttarakhand. The courts have made a distinction between domicile acquired originally and after marriage. In the case of a woman whose original domicile was some other state, she cannot be entitled to the benefits of reservation in Uttarakhand just by virtue of being married to a person having his domicile in Uttarakhand.

The same is true of an original domicile of Uttarakhand who marries elsewhere. Candidates need to refer to the notification of recruitment before making such claims.

Keep Domicile Documents Accurate

The process of document verification forms an integral part of the recruitment procedure in government. It is essential that all information given by the candidates on their application form is consistent with the certificates and record books.

Some of the most significant documents are as follows:

  • Permanent residence or domicile certificate
  • High school and intermediate certificates
  • Caste certificate (if any)
  • OBC non-creamy layer certificate (if any)
  • Proof of employment registration (if any)
  • Educational certificates
  • Identity and address certificates

It is important to verify the period of validity and prescribed format of certificates. Otherwise, an otherwise eligible candidate may find themselves in trouble during the verification process.

Avoid Multiple Domicile Certificates

Domicile certificates from more than one state must never be maintained or used by candidates for claiming any contradictory benefits. The state government of Uttarakhand has also taken such steps against those who have been using their permanent residence certificates in addition to those of some other states.

It may result in many problems for the candidates at the time of recruitment and appointments if inaccurate information is provided along with invalid certificates.

How to Obtain a Uttarakhand Permanent Residence Certificate

The candidates who require a residence certificate should apply following the proper procedures of Uttarakhand, for example, applying at Apuni Sarkar website or revenue department. Documents required for the application may be the records from the family register, education certificates, records of land or property, utility bill, ration card, and proof of residence.

Document requirements can vary based on different factors and the rules prevailing at that particular time. Therefore, applicants should confirm all the details regarding documents before making an application.

Practical Checklist Before Applying

  1. Read the domicile and eligibility clause in the current notification.
  2. Ascertain whether permanent residence is a requirement or for reservation only.
  3. Verify whether completion of education in Uttarakhand will meet another eligibility criterion.
  4. Find out about any need for employment registration.
  5. Ensure that each and every certificate has been issued by the authorized body and is valid.
  6. Ensure that personal information matches in all certificates.
  7. Get original certificates ready for document verification.
  8. Not claim the benefit of reservation without the necessary certificate.

Conclusion

Avoiding domicile related issues can easily be done through proper handling of the same while applying for Uttarakhand government jobs. Applicants must get their respective certificate for permanent residence in time if required, ensure consistency of personal and residence particulars, and make sure to have a separate certificate if applying under reservation category. Above all, eligibility criteria should always be confirmed from the latest recruitment notification as these can differ according to posts as well as the concerned recruiting agency.

The Delhi Police, Home Guards, and Civil Defence all provide various kinds of openings. While these positions fall under the greater category of Delhi Government Jobs, each is selected via a different body and also does not provide the same type of service terms. The Delhi Police Constable position is that of a regular government employee, while those of the Home Guards and Civil Defence Volunteers are different types of volunteer positions.

Delhi Police Constable (Executive)

Who recruits: The recruitment is conducted by the Staff Selection Commission (SSC) for Delhi Police. The recruitment is carried out by the Staff Selection Commission (SSC) on behalf of the Delhi Police.

Most recent cycle: The year 2025 witnessed the recruitment of 7,565 Constable (Executive) vacancies, where the computer-based test result was announced on 19 June 2026. Different websites give vacancy details as well as results for different dates; hence, you should depend only on the notification posted on ssc.gov.in. Some aggregator sites say that there will be an announcement soon, which I couldn't confirm yet.

Eligibility

  • Nationality: Citizen of India.
  • Age: 18-25 years on July 1, 2025, with upper age relaxed for reserved categories. There is relaxation for current Delhi Police personnel and children of police personnel too, so see notice for your category.
  • Education: Passed 12th class examination with Light Motor Vehicle Licence for male candidates. See the stage of getting the licence.
  • Physical qualifications: Minimum 170 cm height and chest of 81 cm unexpanded with 4 cm minimum expansion is needed for male candidates. For women, the requirements are 157 cm height without any chest measurement. There are relaxations for hill area residents, Scheduled Tribes, and some others.
  • Application Fee: Rs 100 with no fee for female, SC, ST, and ex-servicemen candidates.

Selection stages

  1. A computer-based test.
  2. A physical endurance and measurement test (running, jumping and body measurements).
  3. A medical examination.
  4. Document verification.

Salary and Benefits

Police Constables of Delhi police are paid according to the Pay Level 3 under the recommendations of 7th Central Pay Commission. Their pay scale is between Rs 21,700 to Rs 69,100. Newly recruited constables will have the starting salary of Rs 21,700 as their basic pay.

As per one estimate, in-hand pay of Police Constables of Delhi police ranges between ₹32,000 to ₹40,000 per month. The other estimate considering DA at 60% gives the range as ₹36,000 to ₹43,000 per month. The exact amount will depend on DA, posting, and other deductions. These are just estimates, and the only document which provides the right information is the appointment letter.

Delhi Home Guards

Recruitment done by: The recruitment of the said volunteers is done by the Directorate General of Home Guards, Delhi, and not by the SSC. These Home Guards are volunteers who help the police force in their work, not the police themselves.

Last recruitment: The recruitment drive that took place in January 2024 was for a total of 10,285 volunteers for a period of three years, which can be extended further by two more years. The sanctioned number of the volunteers is 10,285, including women Home Guards. There were some legal complications in the recruitment process of the above recruitment. The legal complication stopped the recruitment of 7,939 posts, while the appointment letters were authorized for 2,346 applicants who had cleared the test.

Eligibility

  • Age: Above 25 and under 45 at the time of application, age relaxation considered.
  • Education: Requires At least class 12, or class 10 if former serviceman / CAPF personnel.
  • Citizenship/Residence: Indian citizen and resident of National Capital Territory of Delhi, proved by valid documents.
  • Application Fee: Rs 100, plus a service charge.
  • Selection: A physical standard test and eligibility test, followed by a written test.
  • Bonus marks: Marks will be allotted for previous experience in Home Guard (maximum 8), Civil Defence (maximum 6) and particular Civil Defence training certificates (3).

Pay: According to the Lt. Governor’s office, volunteer salaries were going to be Rs 25,000 per month. The Directorate also maintains an out-of-pocket allowance schedule by type of duty, published daily. It is an allowance and not level 3 salary, which can be changed. Please verify the amount on the official website.

Civil Defence Volunteers

Civil Defence helps in training people on how to react in case of any natural disaster, first aid, and emergency relief. It is voluntary service and does not earn you a salary. The function of Civil Defence in Delhi became different from late 2023 onwards. There was an end to the services provided by Civil Defence volunteers as bus marshals and the Lieutenant Governor issued orders that the former Civil Defence volunteers should be granted 10 extra points in the selection process of Home Guards.

Avoiding Fraud

  • Only apply via ssc.gov.in, delhipolice.gov.in, and delhihomeguards.nic.in.
  • Never pay anyone for selection; official charges are very small, which can be paid through the website only.
  • Never believe any call/ message promising selection.
  • Maintain your certificates, ID proofs and residence proofs up-to-date as they will be verified.

Final Thought

Vacancies, dates, eligibility, physical standards, and payment methods may be different each time there is a new notification. If you are looking for Delhi Police Constable jobs, it is better to follow the SSC notifications for the latest information. For Delhi Home Guards and Civil Defence jobs, candidates must refer to Delhi Government Jobs. This will help candidates avoid outdated, false information and payments.

item.title: SSC CPO SI Exam Guide: Driving License, Tattoo Rules and Medical Standards
item.content:encoded:
The SSC CPO exam takes in candidates as Sub-Inspectors for Delhi Police and CAPF. Being successful in the written Exam is a significant step, but candidates have to qualify themselves in terms of document, physical, and medical fitness too. It is one of the most challenging Sarkari Exams, so SSC CPO preparation becomes very crucial at all levels. In this article, we will discuss three aspects where candidates might find themselves struggling, and what they need to keep in mind for further selection.

Latest Update

SSC CPO 2026 notification was issued on September 10, 2026, on ssc.gov.in, and the application process will take place from September 10, 2026 to September 30, 2026. As there is a discrepancy in vacancy numbers (around 1,871 and 2,018 tentative vacancies), please take notification as the ultimate source. Selection will be done on the basis of Paper-I, PST/PET, Paper-II, and DME (Detailed Medical Examination). Considering that the application process may be over, this article can be helpful for documentation and medical purposes for next time around.

1. Driving License Requirement

A driving license is one of the most frequent grounds for rejection in the documentation stage.

  • Who requires it: A valid LMV Driving License is compulsory for male candidates appearing for Delhi Police SI.
  • Who does not require it: Female candidates of Delhi Police are an exception. Candidates, who have applied for CAPF positions alone, do not need a license.
  • At which stage is the requirement assessed: The applicant must have a valid LMV Driving License while giving the Physical Endurance and Standard Test in case he is applying for Delhi Police SI position. The requirement is not applicable while filing application; however, the candidate should possess it during the PET/PST stage.
  • Hint: Candidates should get their licenses well in advance, since the process could take several weeks. A Learner’s License is not generally acceptable. Candidates not having a license are generally disqualified for Delhi Police but still eligible for CAPF positions.

2. Tattoo Rules

Tattoos are not an automatic ground for disqualification but are highly regulated and examined by the medical board very rigorously.

Permissible Tattoos:

  • The tattoos on conventional places like the inside of the left forearm (non-saluting arm) or dorsum of the hands are permissible.
  • The size of the tattoo has to be less than one fourth of the body part where the tattoo is located, for example, the elbow or wrist.
  • The members from the Scheduled Tribe category with their tribal tattoos are generally offered relaxations, depending on the notification and the medical board.

Non-permissible Tattoos:

  • Any tattoo on the chest, back, neck, face, upper arm or right arm is not allowed.
  • Any tattoo other than the inside of the left forearm is not permissible. The 2024 case of the Delhi High Court on a candidate rejected due to a tattoo on the outer surface of the left forearm clarified that only the inside of the left forearm is permissible.
  • Any tattoo promoting violence, religious hatred or indecency.

The medical board is the final authority here. Most of the time, courts support the decision of the medical board against tattoos violating the notification. Therefore, do not

3. Medical Standards

The DME is of a qualifying nature, hence, there are no marks; it is either you qualify or not. The candidates who are found to be disqualified can seek a second opinion via the Review Medical Examination (RME). The prospects of succeeding in this are quite slim.

Some of the disqualifying ailments include:

  • Knock knees, flat feet, varicose veins, squint eyes and high colour vision of the candidate.
  • Hearing/ speech problems, deformity of any limb and hernia/ hydrocele among others.

Vision:

  • In terms of the vision requirements for SI recruitment, the usual criteria for unaided vision in most forces is 6/6 and 6/9 respectively, without the help of anything like spectacles or contact lenses. However, since there are variations in the standards depending on the force, you should go through the section of the force which you intend to join.
  • The Delhi Police usually allows a more relaxed vision requirement, which is 6/12 with or without glasses.
  • One of the common reasons why a person’s SI application might get rejected is colour blindness, so take that test early.

Physical standards (PST):

  • Individuals need to fulfill the criteria of height, chest, and weight. The eligibility criteria differ from one another according to gender and category; however, there are some relaxations made for candidates falling under the category of ST and specific regions.
  • Bring your admit card, valid ID proof, passport size photos, category certificate, and LMV license for Delhi Police SI.

Preparation Checklist

  1. Read the entire notification. The official PDF available at ssc.gov.in supersedes all blogs, including this one.
  2. Undergo pre-screening. Visiting an ophthalmologist and an orthopedic doctor will help identify vision problems, and flat foot or knock knee problems.
  3. Take a photograph and measure any tattoo you have. Compare its location and dimensions according to the requirements, because even small tattoos may pose problems.
  4. Submit your application for your driving license in case you plan to go with Delhi Police.
  5. Get your documents ready. Category certificates and educational qualifications should have matching names and date of birth.
  6. Have a CAPF option as a contingency. Even if you fail to meet the license requirement or some other requirement for Delhi Police, there is a chance that CAPF posts will be open to you.

Final Word

Marks on paper bring the candidates to physical and medical rounds, but fulfilling all the criteria is mandatory for final selection. In the Sarkari Exam, there are many things that can be checked in advance to avoid any problem, such as securing the license, rules of tattoos, and medical tests. The candidates are supposed to consider the notification of the government to be the ultimate source of information due to the changing eligibility criteria and vacancies from one recruitment to another.

item.title: IBPS RRB Clerk Sarkari Result 2026: State-Wise Merit List and Local Language Proficiency Test Guide
item.content:encoded:
IBPS RRB Clerk Sarkari Result 2026 is the result and provisional allotment system for the post of Office Assistant (Multipurpose) in Regional Rural Banks (RRBs). The most important point to keep in mind regarding this result is that the CRP-RRBs-XIV round has reached the stage of reserve list. In this regard, IBPS has announced the provisional allotment of Office Assistants from reserve list on 30 September 2026. On the other hand, the next round of CRP-RRBs-XV has already commenced. The office assistant preliminary examinations will be held in December 2026.

IBPS RRB Clerk Result 2026 Latest Update

Provisional Allotment under Reserve List for Office Assistants (Multipurpose) in relation to CRP-RRBs-XIV recruitment has been released by IBPS on 30 September 2026. Candidates appearing for this particular recruitment drive must view their result by logging on to the official website of IBPS through their roll number and password or date of birth, whichever is applicable.

The result must not be confused with the new CRP-RRBs-XV recruitment drive. Applications for the new RRBs-XV Office Assistants are being accepted from 1 September to 27 September 2026. Preliminary examination for RRBs-XV is to be held on 6, 12 and 13 December 2026. Hence, the RRB Clerk XV result would be announced later on.

How to Check IBPS RRB Clerk Sarkari Result 2026

The following procedure may be followed by the candidates for checking their results:

  1. Log into the official website of IBPS.
  2. Go to the CRP RRBs tab.
  3. Choose the desired recruitment drive, for example, CRP-RRBs-XIV.
  4. Access the result or provisional allotment link of Office Assistant (Multipurpose).
  5. Log in using the requisite login details.
  6. Check their result after submitting the information.
  7. Keep the printout of the result page.

Candidates need to check the recruitment cycle very carefully as IBPS conducts several recruitment drives at the same time.

State-Wise Merit List for RRB Clerk

Recruitment process for the RRB Office Assistant job openings is done based on the vacancies allotted to the participating RRBs in respective states. So, merit and allotment is determined by the state/RRB vacancies, categories, and candidate performance.

According to IBPS, for the Office Assistant job, only the marks scored in the Online Main Exam will be taken into account while preparing the final merit list. Scores are normalized wherever necessary using the equi-percentile method and even the scores till two decimal points are considered.

The vacancy distribution structure for each state consists of categories like SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), EWS and General along with the other horizontal reservation categories.

Thus, it must be noted that candidates should not evaluate their selection solely on the basis of their marks in relation to a general national cutoff mark.

Is There a Local Language Proficiency Test?

The proficiency in the local language is one such condition which is necessary in recruiting candidates for RRB Office Assistant post. Those candidates who are interested in applying for the post of RRB Office Assistant need to possess proficiency in the local language as prescribed by the RRB.

This condition has been mentioned in the notification issued by RRB. The reason behind the above-mentioned condition is practical in nature since employees of RRB deal with customers from the region where the bank functions. It is thus important for candidates to check the local language of the respective state/RRB.

What Happens in the Local Language Proficiency Test?

Local Language Proficiency Test (wherever applicable) aims to test the candidate’s capability of communicating in the prescribed local language. The candidate must be able to show practical knowledge of the language in the following ways:

  • Ability to read and comprehend the local language
  • Writing simple words or sentences
  • Communicate with the customers
  • Conversing about common banking topics
  • Answering some basic questions in the prescribed language

The details of the process, exemptions, and documents required may vary according to the recruitment notification. Hence, candidates should refer to the instructions given by IBPS and RRB concerned regarding the test.

State-Wise Local Language Examples

The local language stated in the notification also varies from state to state and institute to institute: For RRB recruitment Telangana and Andhra Pradesh: Telugu, Assam: Assamese / Bengali / Bodo, Gujarat: Gujarati, Kerala: Malayalam, Maharashtra: Marathi, Odisha: Odia, Punjab: Punjabi, Tamil Nadu: Tamil, Telangana: Telugu / Urdu, Uttar Pradesh: Hindi / Urdu, West Bengal: Bengali / Nepali.

Candidates are advised to crosscheck the language with their RRB as prescribing language is an eligibility criterion.

RRB Clerk Merit List vs Result

The outcome usually informs a candidate about his/her qualification or provisional allotment, whereas merit list refers to the position of selection on the basis of selection criteria.

In case of selection for RRB Office Assistant, the marks scored in the main exam hold prime importance. There is no interview process involved in the selection of Office Assistants, unlike Officer Scale-I. Hence, candidates should concentrate on their performance in the main exam, competition in categories, vacancies in states and other eligibility criteria.

What Candidates Should Do After Selection?

Candidates having their names on provisional allotment must adhere to all the guidelines provided by the IBPS as well as the allotted RRB. It is possible that some candidates may have to undergo document verification and fulfill other eligibility requirements before joining.

All candidates must ensure that they have all their educational certificates, identity proof, category certificate, photographs, etc., available.

Final Words

IBPS RRB Clerk Sarkari Result 2026 must be considered depending on their respective recruitment schedule, state, and category. In the case of CRP-RRBs-XIV, IBPS has already announced the provisional allotment list of reserve list for Office Assistant on 30 September 2026. In the coming cycle of CRP-RRBs-XV, the prelims test will be conducted in December 2026. Students must refer to the official IBPS notification before making any choice.

item.title: [TIL] Spring Boot | Association Mapping & Spring Security
item.content:encoded:
0. 지난 TIL 회고 및 정정

[TIL] Spring Boot | JPA & Hibernate 에서 이어집니다.

  • 지난 TIL | 📌 Spring 환경에서의 JPA 에서 트랜잭션 전파를 설명하며 "Service 메서드가 끝날 때까지 하나의 영속성 컨텍스트가 유지"된다고 정리해, 영속성 컨텍스트와 트랜잭션을 같은 개념처럼 서술했습니다.

    하지만 트랜잭션은 DB에서 작업 단위의 원자성을 보장하는 개념이고, 영속성 컨텍스트는 애플리케이션 메모리에서 엔티티를 관리하는 공간으로 실행 계층이 다릅니다. 스프링의 기본 전략(트랜잭션 범위 영속성 컨텍스트)은 영속성 컨텍스트의 생존 범위를 트랜잭션 범위와 같게 묶어 둘 뿐이며, Spring Boot는 여기에 OSIV를 기본으로 켜 두어 범위가 더 넓어집니다.

    OSIV가 켜져 있으면 영속성 컨텍스트가 트랜잭션보다 오래 살아남고, 순수 JPA 환경에서는 하나의 EntityManager로 여러 트랜잭션을 실행할 수 있습니다. 또한 트랜잭션을 rollback해도 DB만 되돌아갈 뿐, 메모리의 엔티티 객체 값은 되돌아가지 않습니다.

🔍 LocalDateTime 적용된 BaseEntity 소스코드 
@Getter
        @MappedSuperclass
        @EntityListeners(AuditingEntityListener.class)
        public abstract class BaseEntity {
        
        @CreatedDate
        @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false, updatable = false)
        private LocalDateTime createdAt;
        
        @LastModifiedDate
        @Column(name = "updated_at", nullable = false)
        private LocalDateTime updatedAt;
        }

  • 지난 TIL | 📌 JPA Auditing 에서 Timestamped에는 @Temporal(TemporalType.TIMESTAMP)를 붙였는데, @Temporal은 옛 Date/Calendar 타입용 어노테이션이고 LocalDateTime은 Hibernate가 알아서 timestamp로 매핑하므로 제거했습니다. 실제로 PostgreSQL에 timestamp(6) 컬럼으로 생성되는 것을 확인했습니다.

  • 지난 TIL | 4. 앞으로의 학습 계획 에서 예고한 인증/인가와 JWT는 기존 메모 프로젝트에 적용해 보며 학습했지만, 새 프로젝트에는 아직 적용하지 않아 내일 구현하며 함께 정리하겠습니다.


지난 [TIL] Spring Boot | 3-Layer Architecture & JDBC 의 내용 중, 오늘 과제를 진행하며 다시 보게 된 부분을 정정합니다.

  • 지난 TIL | ❌ Issue 1. 데이터 삭제 거부 현상 에서 3번 방식(ON DELETE SET NULL)을 "자식 데이터를 보존할 수 있어 안전해 보인다"고 평가했습니다.

    하지만 exam.student_code는 DDL에서 NOT NULL로 선언된 컬럼입니다. NOT NULL은 데이터 무결성을 보장하겠다는 명시적인 선언이므로, 부모 데이터가 삭제된다고 해서 이 컬럼이 NULL로 바뀔 수는 없습니다. 즉 3번은 현재 DDL에서 성립하지 않는 선택지였습니다.

    또한 당시 최종 결정에서 "student_code가 NULL이 되면 exam_id, score는 의미 없는 데이터가 된다"고 판단한 부분은 유효하지만, 그 대안으로 채택한 ON DELETE CASCADE 역시 시험 기록을 물리적으로 지워 버린다는 한계가 있습니다. 데이터를 지우는 순간 정합성 문제는 피할 수 있지만, 기록 자체가 사라집니다.

    이 문제를 우회하는 대중적인 방법은 레코드를 DELETE하지 않고, 사용 여부 플래그(use_yn, is_deleted 등)로 데이터의 생명주기를 통제하는 것(Soft Delete) 입니다. 조회할 때 WHERE is_deleted = false처럼 1차로 걸러 내면, 서비스에서는 삭제된 것처럼 보이면서도 참조하는 데이터와의 관계는 그대로 유지됩니다.

    오늘 과제에서 메뉴 삭제를 Soft Delete로 설계한 이유가 바로 이것입니다. 주문(orders)이 메뉴(menus)를 참조하고 있어 메뉴를 실제로 지우면 주문 기록이 깨지므로, Menu에 isDeleted 필드를 두고 삭제 요청 시 값만 바꾸도록 했습니다.

  • 지난 TIL | 📌 JDBC 에서 "JdbcTemplate은 Java와 DB 사이의 데이터 요청을 중재한다"고만 정리해, JdbcTemplate이 DB와 직접 통신하는 것처럼 읽힐 여지가 있었습니다. 실제 흐름은 다음과 같습니다.

    JdbcTemplate → DataSource → DB Connection → JDBC Driver → DB Engine

    JDBC는 Java 애플리케이션이 DB와 통신하기 위한 표준 API 명세이고, JDBC Driver는 그 API를 특정 DBMS에 맞게 구현한 구현체입니다. 따라서 DBMS가 바뀌면 드라이버를 교체해야 합니다. 또한 JdbcTemplate처럼 SQL을 직접 작성하는 방식이라면 AUTO_INCREMENT 같은 DBMS별 문법 차이도 함께 확인해야 합니다.

    같은 글에서 "update() 메서드는 DB의 CUD 작업을 총괄한다"고 쓴 표현도 정정합니다. Java 애플리케이션의 CRUD와 DBMS의 CRUD는 실행 계층이 다릅니다. update()는 애플리케이션의 생성·수정·삭제 요청을 JDBC를 통해 대상 DBMS에 INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE SQL로 발생시키는 메서드이고, DB 내부의 트랜잭션 처리까지 총괄하는 것은 아닙니다.

  • 지난 TIL | 📌 3-Layer Architecture & IoC/DI 에서 "진정한 단위 테스트가 가능해졌다"고 표현했는데, 이는 당시 작성한 Service 코드에 한정된 이야기였습니다. 3계층 구조의 핵심은 Presentation · Business · Data Access로 역할과 책임을 분리하고, 각 계층의 의존성을 외부에서 주입받아 관리하는 데 있고, 그 결과로 테스트가 쉬워지는 것으로 정리하는 것이 정확합니다.

    같은 글에서 "단 하나의 객체만 생성해 재사용하게 되어 메모리가 극단적으로 절약된다"는 표현도 정정합니다. 싱글톤 Bean의 주된 목적은 스프링 컨테이너가 객체의 생성부터 소멸까지 생명주기를 관리하는 것이고, 메모리 절약은 부수적인 이점입니다. 오늘 PasswordConfig에 등록한 PasswordEncoder도 UserService가 직접 new로 만들지 않고, 스프링 컨테이너가 생성·관리하는 Bean을 주입받아 사용합니다.

2. 핵심 개념 정리 및 역할 파악

📌 ERD

요구사항을 바탕으로 erd.dbml을 먼저 작성한 뒤, dbdiagram.io에서 ERD를 생성했습니다. 이 ERD를 요구사항과 함께 Claude(Opus 5.5)로 교차 검증해 설계 누락이나 논리적 오류를 점검했고, 각 테이블의 역할을 반영해 위 erd.png로 정리했습니다.

📌 Association Mapping

@ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
        @JoinColumn(name = "owner_id", nullable = false)
        private User owner;

DB의 menus 테이블에는 owner_id라는 숫자가 저장되지만, 엔티티에서는 Long ownerId가 아니라 User 객체를 필드로 둡니다. 저장 시점에 JPA가 객체의 id를 꺼내 외래키 컬럼에 넣어 줍니다. 그래서 필드 이름은 owner, 컬럼 이름은 @JoinColumn이 담당합니다.

항목 내용
@ManyToOne 메뉴 N : 사장님 1. 외래키를 가진 쪽(N)에 선언
fetch = LAZY @ManyToOne의 기본값은 EAGER라 직접 지정. 실제로 사용할 때 조회
@JoinColumn(nullable = false) 외래키의 NOT NULL 제약은 @Column이 아닌 @JoinColumn에 선언

과제의 연관관계 4개(Menu→User, Order→Menu, Order→User, Payment→Order)는 모두 N:1이라 같은 방식으로 매핑했습니다. 또한 user, order는 PostgreSQL 예약어와 겹칠 수 있어 @Table(name = "users")처럼 복수형 테이블 이름을 사용했습니다.

📌 Spring Security

🔍 SecurityConfig 소스코드 
@Bean
        public SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
        http.csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable());
        http.formLogin(form -> form.disable());
        http.httpBasic(basic -> basic.disable());
        
        http.sessionManagement(session ->
        session.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS));
        
        http.authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth
        .requestMatchers("/error").permitAll()
        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/api/users").permitAll()
        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/api/auth/login").permitAll()
        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/api/menus").permitAll()
        );
        
        return http.build();
        }
설정 이유
csrf.disable() 토큰을 쿠키가 아닌 헤더로 보내므로 CSRF 공격의 전제가 성립하지 않음
formLogin, httpBasic disable 화면이 없는 API 서버이고, 로그인은 API로 처리
STATELESS 서버가 세션에 로그인 상태를 저장하지 않고, 매 요청의 토큰으로 확인
/error permitAll 예외가 발생하면 /error로 다시 요청되는데, 이 경로가 막혀 있으면 400·409 응답이 본문 없는 403으로 바뀜

현재는 회원가입 API(POST /api/users)만 구현했지만, 이후 추가할 로그인 API(POST /api/auth/login)와 메뉴 조회 API(GET /api/menus)도 로그인 없이 접근할 수 있도록 미리 등록해 두었습니다.

/api/menus처럼 같은 경로라도 조회(GET)는 누구나, 이후 추가할 등록(POST)은 사장님만 가능하므로 HttpMethod로 구분했습니다.

PasswordEncoder가 SecurityConfig 안에 있으면 UserService는 SecurityConfig를 참조하게 됩니다. 이후 SecurityConfig가 JWT 인증을 위해 UserService 쪽을 참조하게 되면 두 Bean이 서로를 참조하는 순환 참조가 생길 수 있어 미리 분리했습니다.

📌 BCrypt

$2a$ 10 $ N9qo8uLOickgx2ZMRZoMye IjZAgcfl7p92ldGxad68LJZdL17lhWy
        버전 cost      salt(22자)              해시(31자)

BCrypt는 복호화가 가능한 암호화가 아니라 단방향 해시입니다. 같은 비밀번호를 넣어도 매번 다른 salt가 붙어 결과가 달라지므로, 미리 계산해 둔 해시표(레인보우 테이블)로 역추적하기 어렵습니다.

  • 비교 방법: 로그인할 때는 equals()로 비교할 수 없고, 저장된 값에서 salt를 꺼내 같은 방식으로 다시 해시하는 passwordEncoder.matches(입력값, 저장값)을 사용합니다.
  • cost: 2^cost번 반복한다는 뜻으로, 일부러 느리게 만들어 무차별 대입 공격을 어렵게 합니다.

📌 Response DTO & ResponseEntity

@PostMapping("/users")
        public ResponseEntity<UserResponse> signup(@Valid @RequestBody SignupRequest signupRequest) {
        UserResponse userResponse = userService.signup(signupRequest);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(userResponse);
        }

DTO만 반환하면 상태 코드는 항상 200이 되지만, 회원가입은 리소스가 새로 생성되었으므로 201을 응답해야 합니다. ResponseEntity는 상태 코드, 헤더, 본문을 직접 지정할 수 있는 응답 객체입니다.

실패 응답(400, 409)은 Controller에서 만들지 않습니다. Service에서 ResponseStatusException을 던지면 Spring이 해당 상태 코드로 응답해 줍니다. 그래서 Controller는 성공 흐름만 담고 있습니다.

if (userRepository.existsByUsername(request.getUsername())) {
        throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "이미 사용 중인 아이디입니다.");
        }

📌 Bean Validation

입력 @NotNull @NotBlank
null ❌ ❌
"" ✅ 통과 ❌
" " ✅ 통과 ❌
  • 문자열은 @NotBlank, 숫자나 enum은 @NotNull을 사용합니다.
  • @Size, @Min은 null을 통과시키므로 필수값이라면 함께 선언해야 합니다.

검증 어노테이션은 규칙을 선언할 뿐이고, 검증을 실행하는 주체가 있어야 동작합니다. 이 프로젝트에서는 Controller 파라미터의 @Valid가 그 역할을 합니다.

처음에는 Repository의 existsByUsername(@NotBlank String username)처럼 파라미터에도 붙였는데, 이 위치에는 검증을 실행하는 설정(@Valid, 클래스 단위 @Validated)이 없어 어노테이션이 동작하지 않습니다. 입력 검증은 Controller의 요청 DTO에서 한 번만 하도록 정리했습니다.

📌 Query Methods

boolean existsByUsername(String username);

지난 TIL에서 배운 Query Methods를 중복 아이디 확인에 사용했습니다. Username은 DB 컬럼이 아니라 엔티티의 필드 이름을 기준으로 합니다. 존재 여부만 필요하므로 엔티티 전체를 조회하는 findByUsername().isPresent()보다 exists가 가볍습니다.

다만 두 요청이 동시에 들어오면 둘 다 exists 검사를 통과할 수 있습니다. 그래서 @Column(unique = true)로 DB에 제약을 걸어 마지막 안전장치로 두었습니다.

❌ Issue 1. Gradle이 JDK 21을 찾지 못함

  • 문제 상황 | 프로젝트 생성 후 빌드 시 Cannot find a Java installation ... matching languageVersion=21 에러가 발생하고, Project Structure의 SDK가 빨간색으로 표시됨.

  • 원인 분석 | IntelliJ에서 JDK 21(temurin) 다운로드가 끝나기 전에 프로젝트를 열어 SDK 경로가 비어 있었습니다. build.gradle의 toolchain은 21을 요구하는데 실제 설치된 JDK가 없었습니다.

  • 해결 방안 | JDK를 다시 다운로드하고, Settings → Gradle → Gradle JVM을 temurin-21로 지정했습니다.


❌ Issue 2. 주문 총액을 어디서 계산할 것인가

  • 문제 상황 | 주문 총액(totalPrice)은 메뉴 가격 × 수량인데, 이 계산을 어느 계층에 둘지 정해야 했음.

  • 원인 분석 | 총액을 클라이언트에게 받으면 금액을 조작할 수 있고, 메뉴 가격이 나중에 바뀌어도 주문 당시 금액은 남아 있어야 하므로 서버가 주문 시점에 계산해 저장해야 합니다.

  • 해결 방안 |

    1. Service에서 계산 후 Order에 전달 | 처음 설계 문서에 기록한 방식

    • 비즈니스 로직은 Service에 둔다는 익숙한 구조이지만, Order 생성자가 총액을 외부에서 받기 때문에 잘못된 총액을 가진 Order도 만들어질 수 있습니다.

    2. Order 생성자에서 계산 | ✅ new Order(menu, customer, quantity, address) 내부에서 menu.getPrice() * quantity로 계산하는 방식

    • 총액을 받는 경로 자체가 없어 잘못된 총액을 가진 Order가 만들어질 수 없습니다.

    • 최종 결정 | 엔티티를 직접 작성하다 보니, 총액은 Order가 반드시 지켜야 하는 규칙이라 Order 스스로 계산하는 편이 안전하다고 판단해 2번으로 변경했습니다. 처음 결정(D-04)은 지우지 않고 대체됨으로 남겨, 생각이 바뀐 과정을 기록했습니다(D-07).

🔍 변경된 Order 생성자 소스코드 
public Order(Menu menu, User customer, Long quantity, String address) {
        this.menu = menu;
        this.customer = customer;
        this.quantity = quantity;
        this.address = address;
        this.totalPrice = menu.getPrice() * quantity; // 총액은 Order가 직접 계산
        }

❌ Issue 3. 응답 DTO에 password가 포함됨

  • 문제 상황 | 회원가입 응답 DTO를 User 엔티티를 보고 작성하다가 password 필드까지 넣음. 이대로라면 BCrypt 해시값이 응답에 그대로 노출됨.

  • 원인 분석 | 응답 DTO를 API 명세의 응답 예시가 아니라 엔티티 필드를 기준으로 만들었습니다.

  • 해결 방안 |

    1. 엔티티를 그대로 반환하고 @JsonIgnore 선언 | 엔티티의 password 필드를 JSON 변환에서 제외하는 방식

    • 코드는 줄지만, 엔티티가 JSON 응답 형식까지 책임지게 되고 Controller까지 노출됩니다.

    2. 응답 DTO에서 password 필드 제거 | ✅ API 명세의 응답 예시를 기준으로 userId, username, role, createdAt만 두는 방식

    • 응답에 나갈 값만 DTO에 정의되므로, 노출 범위가 코드에 명확히 드러납니다.

    • 최종 결정 | 응답 DTO에 password 필드가 아예 없으면 실수로도 노출될 수 없으므로 2번을 채택했습니다. 엔티티의 id를 응답에서는 userId로 내보내는 것처럼, DB 구조와 API 응답을 분리할 수 있다는 점도 DTO를 따로 두는 이유라는 것을 다시 확인했습니다.


❌ Issue 4. Declaration not allowed here

  • 문제 상황 | 중복 아이디 검사 if문 다음 줄의 변수 선언에서 Declaration not allowed here 컴파일 에러가 발생함.

  • 원인 분석 | if문을 중괄호 없이 작성해, 다음 문장이 if의 몸체로 해석되었습니다. Java에서는 변수 선언이 중괄호 없는 if의 몸체로 단독으로 올 수 없습니다. 에러는 선언문에서 났지만 실제 원인은 바로 윗줄이었습니다.

  • 해결 방안 | if문에 중괄호를 추가하고 그 안에서 예외를 던지도록 수정했습니다. 앞으로 if문은 한 줄이어도 항상 {}를 사용하기로 했습니다.


❌ Issue 5. Postman 일괄 테스트에서 400과 409가 섞여 나옴

  • 문제 상황 | 회원가입 성공·실패 10개 케이스를 한 번에 확인하려고 요청 본문에 JSON 10개를 이어 붙였더니 400이 발생함. 스크립트로 바꾼 뒤에는 두 번째 실행부터 성공 케이스가 409로 실패함.

  • 원인 분석 | 요청 본문은 JSON 하나만 받을 수 있어 여러 개를 붙이면 파싱에 실패합니다. 두 번째 문제는 첫 실행에서 가입된 아이디가 DB에 남아 있어, 같은 아이디로 다시 가입하면 의도대로 409가 나온 것이었습니다.

  • 해결 방안 | Post-response 스크립트에서 pm.sendRequest로 케이스를 하나씩 순서대로 보내고 pm.test로 기대 상태 코드를 검증하도록 바꿨습니다. 반복 실행 전에는 DB를 비우고 실행합니다.

4. 앞으로의 학습 계획

오늘 회원가입 API까지 완성해 201, 400, 409 응답을 모두 확인했습니다. 내일은 로그인 API에서 matches()로 비밀번호를 비교하고 JWT를 발급하며, JWT 비밀키는 GitHub에 올리지 않도록 환경변수로 관리할 예정입니다. 이후 JWT 필터를 등록해 요청마다 토큰을 검증하고, 역할(OWNER, CUSTOMER)별 접근 규칙을 SecurityConfig에 추가한 뒤 메뉴 CRUD(Soft Delete)와 주문 API를 구현하겠습니다.

item.title: Study Leave and Child Care Leave (CCL): New Leave Rules in Government Jobs
item.content:encoded:
Leaves are an important aspect of government employment and aid the employees in fulfilling their professional commitments along with their educational and domestic requirements. From the various categories of leaves prescribed by the Central Civil Services (Leave) Rules, 1972, Study Leaves and Child Care Leave (CCL) hold great importance. However, there are certain prerequisites for availing of these leaves and the permission from the concerned authorities is required.

There have been changes in the rules over a period of time with respect to CCL. It is therefore advised that the applicants/employees refer to the latest government Jobs in this regard.

What is Study Leave in Government Jobs?

The concept of Study Leave is one of those special leave facilities which give scope to the government employees to undergo advanced studies or professional training that is directly related to their official work. According to Rule 50 of the CCS (Leave) Rules, Study Leave is sanctioned keeping in view the needs of public services.

It is not applicable for all personal educational courses. It is determined by the competent authority on the basis of its relevancy for public service and administrative requirements.

How Much Study Leave Can Be Taken?

For employees of the Central Government, except for the Central Health Service (CHS) officers, Study Leave is usually allowed for a period of 24 months in total throughout the service period, usually 12 months at a stretch. In the case of CHS officers, Study Leave can be extended to 36 months to obtain postgraduate qualifications, under certain conditions.

There is also the requirement of signing a service bond in case of Study Leave. As per the provisions, the general service bond entails three years of service after Study Leave, whereas in the case of CHS officers, the number of years can be five.

Important Conditions for Study Leave

Staff members are supposed to consider that Study Leave is not guaranteed for those who become part of Government Jobs; this is subject to:

  • Relevance of the course to official duties
  • Public interest
  • Administrative requirements
  • Employee's eligibility and service conditions
  • Duration and nature of the course
  • Approval of the competent authority

What is Child Care Leave (CCL)?

The Child Care Leave facility is meant to aid those eligible government servants who need to look after their children, which includes education and sickness etc. The provision of 43-C of CCS (Leave) Rules allows a woman government servant and also a man government servant who is unmarried to get CCL for 730 days in total service period for the first two eldest living children.

Usually, the child should be less than 18 years of age. However, for the child with specific disabilities, there is no such limitation regarding age.

How Many Days of CCL Can Employees Get?

The 730 days' tenure rule covers the whole period of service, and not each year. Some of the conditions associated with it are:

  • Normal CCL can be availed in up to 3 spells in a calendar year.
  • Single woman Government servants can avail it in up to 6 spells in a calendar year.
  • The CCL cannot be available for less than 5 days.
  • The CCL cannot be availed during probation, unless in some very extreme circumstances.

A special relaxation is allowed in case the child is hospitalized. According to the guidelines issued by DoPT on 29th July 2024, the leave sanctioning authority can grant further relaxation of up to 3 spells above the prescribed limit of 3 spells for the specified purpose.

CCL Salary Rules

Pursuant to the present 43-C, CCL is payable at:

  • 100% of Salary for the first 365 days
  • 80% of Salary for the next 365 days

This means that employees of Government Jobs should no longer base their information on old news stating that the total 730 days will be paid in 100% salary.

Is CCL an Automatic Right?

CCL is not something that can be availed without permission. As per the Department of Personnel and Training, CCL is not a right but rather depends upon the approval of the competent authority. The administrative requirements and leave conditions remain intact.

It is all the more essential for those employees who have family obligations pending urgently. They should first avail themselves of the leave facility and then remain away from work.

Study Leave vs CCL: Key Difference

CCL and Study Leave differ in terms of objectives. Study Leave is meant for further studies in connection with official duties and public interest. CCL aims to assist eligible employees in meeting childcare obligations.

Study Leave may carry a service bond, whereas the lifetime limit for CCL is 730 days in addition to spell limits every year. This can prove to be advantageous for eligible employees in Govt Jobs.

Do These Rules Apply to Every Government Employee?

This is not always the case. CCS (Leave) Rules regulate Central Government employees who come under the purview of these rules. The employees of State Government are governed by the leave rules of individual State Governments. Likewise, DoPT Orders are not automatically binding on the employees of PSUs, autonomous bodies, banks and other institutions. It is up to the authority concerned to implement these instructions.

In conclusion, employees need to go through their service rules and recent orders issued by the concerned authority before availing of Study Leave or CCL.

Conclusion

Study Leave and Child Care Leave are very significant provisions made available to eligible government job holders. According to the central government system, Study Leave will typically be for up to 24 months in total within the service tenure, while CCL would be for 730 days for the two oldest surviving children. As leave is conditional and needs approval, the guidelines of the relevant department must be confirmed before application.
